pdf.js (PDF.js) — Mozilla
Version: 5.4.530
License: Apache License 2.0 — see pdfjs/LICENSE
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Vendored from Persephone's own `assets/pdfjs/` copy, already pruned of files that are
useless in a shipped app (~10 MB):

- source maps removed: build/pdf.mjs.map, build/pdf.worker.mjs.map,
  build/pdf.sandbox.mjs.map, web/viewer.mjs.map
- the trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=` line stripped from each corresponding .mjs
- pdf.js's own sample document removed: web/compressed.tracemonkey-pldi-09.pdf
  (it is the stock viewer's `defaultUrl` fallback, unreachable here because the board
  always supplies `?file=`)

Deliberately kept, because removing them breaks real documents: web/locale/ (viewer UI
translations), web/cmaps/ (CJK), web/standard_fonts/ (non-embedded font fallback),
web/wasm/ (JPEG 2000 decoding), build/pdf.sandbox.mjs (AcroForm JavaScript).

Re-apply the same prune when upgrading pdf.js.
